title: First impression
body: I’m excited about how this app look’s like, nothing to compline about.
author: Lancouch Tom

title: Great all round
body: Perfect app for tracking and improving new habits. I like the design, simplicity of use. Please add more icons for various habits.
author: user32201

title: I would give 5 stars but…
body: Love the app, works perfectly but It really bothers me that I cannot automatically sync the data to my account. The manual import/export is so inconvenient. Would love to see this feature in the future.
author: BeRemembered

title: Recommend!
body: It’s an amazing app to keep your habits. I have tried a lot of different apps, however they didn’t really kept me going that long. I’ve been using HabitKit for half year now and it has really helped me build my habits. Especially if u have the widget it is really easy to see your habits and it’s fun in a way, as if you are to complete daily quests.
author: KyoloK1

title: Love it, it’s exactly what I needed!
body:
I’ve tried quite a few habit tracker apps and nothing came close to this one - It’s extremely simple to use and you can see everything important at first glance when you open the app. Also love how I can customize colors, icons and rearange the habits. 
The premium version is very reasonably priced and I was very happy to purchase it - the creator/creators of this app absolutely deserve the small support!
author: z_2000__
